scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: For the printed polynomial flow the exact identity L_F(x²+y²)=2ay² was independently derived in symbolic algebra. The recurrence and compact invariant-measure consequences were verified analytically; no formal proof assistant or external expert certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: Applies only to a≠0 and b,c>0 and to the exact displayed ODE; excludes non-equilibrium compact recurrence and compact stationary statistical states, not long transients, noncompact orbit behavior or all possible compact invariant sets. Complete Yang–Liu (2019) and Rech (2021) articles were inaccessible; originality is a best-of-knowledge assessment.

title: A monotone radial law excludes recurrent chaos in the Yang–Liu cubic flow
